spec.title: Implement isOverdue(dueOn, today) with strict calendar-date validation
spec.problem: The library loan module needs an isOverdue(dueOn, today) function in src/dates.mjs that determines whether a loan is overdue, given the due date and an explicitly injected "today" value, both as YYYY-MM-DD strings for years 1000-9999. The current implementation does a naive string comparison and does not validate that inputs are real calendar dates (including leap years), so it accepts malformed or impossible dates and produces incorrect boundary results for equal-day comparisons.
scope: Rewrite src/dates.mjs to export isOverdue(dueOn, today) as a named export, preserving the module shape.
Validate both dueOn and today strictly match YYYY-MM-DD format with a 4-digit year in [1000,9999], 2-digit month, 2-digit day.
Validate the parsed year/month/day form a real calendar date, correctly accounting for leap years (e.g. reject 2026-02-29, accept 2024-02-29).
Throw RangeError (not TypeError) for any invalid input: wrong format, non-string, wrong length, out-of-range month/day, non-existent date (e.g. 2026-04-31), or null/undefined.

Compare dates purely as calendar dates (string/numeric comparison of validated Y-M-D components), with no Date object time zone conversion and no reliance on an ambient clock — today is always the injected parameter.
isOverdue returns false when today equals dueOn, and true only when today is strictly later than dueOn calendar-wise.
outOfScope: Any dependency, build, or infrastructure changes.
Time zone handling or use of the system clock.

acceptance.description: isOverdue returns false when today equals dueOn for a valid date.
isOverdue returns true when today is one calendar day after dueOn.
isOverdue returns false when today is before dueOn.
Leap year due date compared correctly against following day in a non-leap month rollover.
Invalid dueOn values (non-existent leap date, invalid month, invalid day-of-month, wrong zero-padding, null, trailing characters) throw RangeError.

acceptance.description: Invalid today values (same invalid set) throw RangeError.
acceptance.verification: node --test test/acceptance.mjs: for each of the same invalid set, mod.isOverdue('2026-09-18',d) throws RangeError

acceptance.description: The fixed acceptance gate passes unmodified.
acceptance.verification: Run: node --test test/acceptance.mjs (all assertions pass, exit code 0)

tasks.title: Implement isOverdue with strict calendar-date validation
tasks.description: Rewrite src/dates.mjs. Export a named function isOverdue(dueOn, today). Validate each argument: must be a string exactly matching /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/ with year between 1000 and 9999 inclusive; parse year/month/day as integers and confirm they form a real calendar date (month 1-12, day valid for that month, correctly handling leap years via the standard Gregorian rule: divisible by 4, except centuries not divisible by 400 unless divisible by 400). Throw `new RangeError(...)` for any failure (wrong type, wrong format, non-existent date). Do not use `new Date(...)` parsing for validation or comparison, since that performs implicit time zone/UTC conversion and can silently roll over invalid dates (e.g. Date accepts 2026-04-31 as May 1) instead of rejecting them. Compare the two validated date strings lexicographically (safe because both are zero-padded YYYY-MM-DD) or via validated numeric Y/M/D tuples; return true only if today is strictly greater than dueOn, false otherwise (including equality). Do not modify test/acceptance.mjs. Optionally add test/regression.mjs with extra coverage (e.g. century leap-year edge cases like 2000-02-29 valid, 1900-02-29 invalid) if useful, but it is not required for acceptance.

experience.rationale: Pure backend/library date-validation logic with no UI surface.

threatModel.summary: Low-risk pure function; only relevant concern is rejecting malformed/out-of-range input rather than silently accepting it (which could cause incorrect overdue determinations downstream).
trustBoundaries: Function boundary between caller-supplied date strings and internal date arithmetic
assumptions: Callers supply today explicitly; no ambient clock or external system is trusted.

requirements.title: Reject malformed or non-existent calendar dates with RangeError instead of silently coercing them
requirements.verification: node --test test/acceptance.mjs covers invalid-input cases and expects RangeError

assumptions: Gregorian calendar leap-year rule applies for the full 1000-9999 year range.
No external test/regression.mjs is required by the acceptance gate; it is optional supplementary coverage.

report.summary: Rewritten src/dates.mjs implements strict YYYY-MM-DD validation (format, year range, month/day bounds, leap-year handling) and compares validated date strings lexicographically without Date/timezone reliance. All acceptance criteria and the single security requirement (SR1) are satisfied by inspection, and the cached acceptance gate receipt shows exit code 0.

criteria.evidence: isOverdue returns today > dueOn; equal strings yield false.
'2026-09-19' > '2026-09-18' lexicographically true, matching calendar order for fixed-width fields.
'2024-03-01' > '2024-02-29' string-compares true; leap year 2024 validated correctly via isLeapYear.

validate() rejects '2026-02-29' (non-leap year, day>28), '2026-13-01' (month>12), '2026-04-31' (day>30), '2026-9-18' (regex requires 2-digit month), null (typeof check), '2026-09-18x' (regex anchored with $) — all throw RangeError.
Same validate() function applied to both dueOn and today, so the identical invalid set throws RangeError for today as well.
Receipt d3086f13 shows acceptance gate cached run with exitCode 0.

observations: No decisions or architecture changes were in scope for this task.
Code contains no stray comments describing evidence/history, satisfying comment-quality guidance.

securityChecks.evidence: validate() throws RangeError for all listed negative cases (invalid leap day, invalid month, invalid day-of-month, non-zero-padded month, null, trailing garbage), covered by AC5/AC6 and the acceptance gate receipt.
